newsitem.title: USA: Alpharma sees Q4 oper net break even or loss.
newsitem.headline: Alpharma sees Q4 oper net break even or loss.

text.p: Alpharma Inc said on Monday that it expects to break even or post a loss in the fourth quarter.

Alpharma, a pharmaceutical company, said it also expects to take extra charges in the fourth quarter related to the reevaluation of business practices and production. It said it does not consider those charges part of operating results.
The company said a variety of factors have led to the projection, including a shift in industry distribution, purchasing and stocking patterns in the U.S. pharmaceutical industry.

The company said those shifts led to a drop in its third quarter sales volume of about 20 percent and a volume decline of more than 50 percent to generic drug distributors. The company said that programs recently initiated by national wholesalers in the U.S. have accelerated those shifts and have fueled a trend of lower prices.
Alpharma also said its animal health division has been hurt by difficult conditions in the U.S. market directly and indirectly related to historically high grain prices.
